beats: The first dog walk suggests a presence without showing a creature.
A later pier glimpse makes fear visible.
Proposed: repeat the shore meeting, learn when to give Lapras space, and let recognition become mutual before recruitment and its later unsettling discovery. Recruitment remains undecided.
An unsettling fact follows attachment. Its content is open.
The legendary’s magic is revealed near the end.

description:
The planned Lapras arc moves from fear through attachment to an unsettling discovery and a late explanation. The Shiohama pier glimpse is an existing prototype; recruitment and the precise disturbing truth remain undecided.

Proposed attachment sequence: after the frightening sighting, repeated shore visits let the same Lapras keep pace offshore, then wait opposite the place where the path climbs away from the water. On one visit it turns away before the child reaches the edge; on another it stays. The child learns when to stop advancing. Later, it turns toward the sound of the child arriving before the lighthouse beam reaches its shell. The player can watch or leave without offending it. After recruitment is separately decided, revisit that place with the companion and let it choose a resting distance. Recognition and a respected boundary build trust before the unsettling disclosure.

sections: Sections 7, 10–13: planned Lapras, Suicune, sabre, recovery and endings
